title: Sub-agent terminal result
description: The sub-agent's final message. Exactly one of three terminal statuses; the status is the entire protocol. Read by the runtime and relayed by the main agent in its own words.

status.description: done = finished and verified by read-back. needs_input = cannot proceed without a human answer; the worker exits carrying the question. failed = it broke.

summary.description: One or two lines: what was actually done, including how it was verified. Anything a human should know goes here.

output.description: Search/read-only tasks: the material actually retrieved, verbatim, with file paths. Not a paraphrase. Empty or absent if nothing was found.

question.description: needs_input only: one sentence, the smallest question that would unblock the work.

error.description: failed only: one line, what broke.
